annotations.text:
Customer confirmation email (server/mailhtml.js › customerHtml), three directions. Same brand: ink #262D40, square corners, Jost / Schibsted Grotesk / Plex Mono. Sample data from tools/mailpreview.js.

In real inboxes most people see Arial and Courier New (Gmail strips web fonts); every layout here can be rebuilt as nested tables.
A · Ficha — a work-order ticket. The code is the hero, details sit in a grid, pieces as tags. Closest to today's email, just tighter. Tradeoff: still reads like a receipt, not a welcome.
B · Seguimiento — leads with what happens next (4 steps, from the home page's flow). Answers the real question after sending: "now what?". Tradeoff: adds a new section; the code is smaller.

C · Carta — a short letter from the shop. The request is retold as one sentence, big code between rules, ink footer. Most personal. Tradeoff: details are prose, harder to scan; long piece lists will stretch the sentence.
